title: DIR-064: Eliminate PDF Blank Page & Skip-Link Bleed, Fix Footer Overlap (Certification Card Geometry), and Centralized Cross-Platform Export Pipeline
spec:
### 1. EXECUTIVE MISSION & PROBLEM STATEMENT
Live user inspection identified three critical defects in resume export and visual pagination:
1. PDF Export First Page Blank with Skip-link Banner: In generated PDFs, Page 1 is almost entirely blank except for an accessibility button Skip to main content rendered at the top, pushing the entire resume to Page 2. Root Cause: .skip-link in index.html has no @media print suppression rules.
2. Content Overlapping and Bleeding Under Page Footer: Multi-item cards (such as Certifications with 2-line titles, issuer lines, and badges e.g. CCRN) bleed directly into and behind .smart-page-footer (Babu M ... 1/1). Root Cause: smartPartitioner.js estimates certification row height at only 52px whereas actual cards take 74px-85px, and .smart-page-body lacks a protective safety buffer above the footer.
3. Cross-Platform Centralized Single-Source Downloader Pipeline: Production deployment is on a standard Linux server. The codebase must NEVER depend on Windows-native tools (winget, PowerShell scripts, Windows-only paths). Downloader logic must be unified into a single cross-platform client (src/utils/exportDownloader.js) for both PDF and DOCX.

### 2. DELIVERABLES
1. Eliminate skip-link and leading blank page in PDF export (add @media print display:none, remove in Exporter.jsx and backend/index.js before page.pdf()).
2. Recalibrate certification row height estimator in smartPartitioner.js (~76px-84px per row + title margin) and add safe bottom clearance in smartEngine.css so cards never collide with the footer.
3. Create centralized single-source downloader src/utils/exportDownloader.js with magic-byte validation (%PDF- and PK zip) and refactor all consumer portals to use it.
4. Verify 100% Linux server compatibility with pure Node.js and Playwright Chromium headless flags.

### 3. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA & EVIDENCE
- Exported PDF starts on Page 1 with resume content and zero blank pages or skip-link text.
- Certification cards have zero overlap or clipping with page footer.
- Centralized export downloader module created and integrated across all portal surfaces.
- 100% test pass on PDF and DOCX export suites with clean build.

plan.summary: DIR-064 P0 REVISED, three export defects, all root causes confirmed by reading source. CONTRACTS/INVARIANTS: existing contracts tests/fouc-prevention.test.mjs, backend/test/p1-gap-source-contract.test.js and tests/fouc-prevention.spec.js require .skip-link to REMAIN in index.html with top:-100px and a :focus top:0.75rem rule, so every change is purely additive; frozen src/cv-templates stays at git diff 0. (A) Skip-link bleed and blank page-1 in PDF: cuba-print.css sets '*' { position: static !important } under @media print, neutralising the off-screen skip-link so it prints as black text on page 1. The skip-link is a keyboard focus affordance for assistive users, so we suppress it on paper ONLY and never strip its aria/focus semantics from the screen DOM. (B) Cert cards clipping into .smart-page-footer: smartPartitioner.js under-estimates a 2-col cert row at 52px vs the real 74-85px card, so the overflow clips at the page-body boundary; fixed with a title-aware 76-84px estimator, a sidebar recalibration, a FOOTER_SAFETY_CLEARANCE subtracted from capacity, and a CSS bottom clearance. (C) No centralized downloader exists; six consumers hand-roll axios+blob. UX STATES: the centralized downloader and each refactored portal expose an explicit loading state while the export request is in flight and a themed empty/error state on failure (no blocking OS dialog, no fabricated file). SECURITY: the export client preserves Bearer token extraction from Firebase getIdToken, never logs the token, and sanitizes filenames against path traversal. PERFORMANCE: the estimator change is a pure O(n) render-budget computation with no extra re-renders and the build stays under the 4.0s budget. QA: static contract tests plus a Playwright browser crawl of the rendered PDF asserting zero console errors and zero skip-link text. No Windows-only tooling; all servers stay on XAMPP.
steps: 1. index.html: append additive '@media print { .skip-link { display:none !important } }' to the critical inline <style>, preserving the current .skip-link top:-100px and its :focus top:0.75rem focus rule so keyboard focus and the fouc-prevention and p1-gap accessibility contracts stay green

2. src/styles/cuba-print.css: add .skip-link to the section-2 print chrome-hiding group so the ONE inlined print contract suppresses it on paper only, leaving aria and focus behaviour intact on screen

3. src/components/Exporter/Exporter.jsx: on export mount remove the static .skip-link from the export document, and render a themed loading state while data resolves plus an empty/error state on failure instead of a blank page

4. backend/index.js: before page.pdf() run page.evaluate to remove any .skip-link and stamp data-print-export, keep Bearer token auth untouched and keep the existing Linux-safe chromium flags (--no-sandbox, --disable-dev-shm-usage, headless)

5. src/engine/hybrid/smartPartitioner.js: replace rowHeight=isNewRow?52:0 with a title-aware certification row estimator (base 76px up to 84px for wrapping 2-line titles) plus title margin, recalibrate certsSidebarHeight from 30px per row to the real card height, and subtract a FOOTER_SAFETY_CLEARANCE from P1_CAPACITY and PN_CAPACITY

6. src/engine/hybrid/smartEngine.css: add a safe bottom clearance on .smart-page-body and break-inside:avoid on .smart-cert-item so no card can clip into .smart-page-footer, without disturbing badge aria-hidden or focus-visible rings

7. create src/utils/exportDownloader.js as the single cross-platform source for PDF plus DOCX, reusing the proven %PDF- and PK validators, sanitizing filenames against path traversal, never logging the Bearer token, exposing downloadResumePdf and downloadResumeDocx with loading and error state hooks

8. refactor all six consumer portals (BuildResume, BoardFilling, DashboardHomepage, PublicResume, JobApplicationsModal, EnterpriseResumePdfModal) to call exportDownloader, each retaining a loading state and a user-facing empty/error state on failure

9. author tests/dir064-pdf-print-export-pipeline.test.mjs static contracts plus a Playwright browser PDF and print crawl verifying zero console errors and zero skip-link text in the rendered output, add npm script test:dir064:print, and leave the existing test:dir064 wake-supersede suite intact

10. evidence: run npm run lint, npm run test:security:static, npm run test:product, the new suite, and npm run build (verify the sub-4s render/build perf budget), then submit logs via bridge dev submit-evidence for Gatekeeper certification.
